name: MyDeputy AI Chat & Booking
author: MyDeputy

sections.description:
AI Chatbot + Smart Booking Terminal for WordPress and WooCommerce

MyDeputy is trained on your business data and helps automate customer conversations, lead capture, and bookings 24/7 from one clean widget.

Start with a 14-day free trial – no credit card required.

AI Chatbot

  • One-click setup – install, connect, and go live in minutes.
  • Automatic website learning – MyDeputy scans and learns from your site content.
  • Train on your own content – website pages, PDF files, WhatsApp, and Telegram updates.
  • Instant messenger training – send Telegram or WhatsApp content such as voice notes, audio menu files, PDF, Word (DOC/DOCX), and images. The bot is trained immediately and can use this information right away in live conversations.
  • Smart answers – handles FAQs, pricing, services, and product questions instantly.
  • WooCommerce ready – helps visitors discover products and make decisions faster.

Smart Booking Terminal

  • Real-time bookings – incoming requests appear instantly for your team.
  • Messenger notifications – booking and lead alerts in WhatsApp or Telegram.
  • Unlimited staff access – your whole team can work from one terminal.
  • Works for many niches – restaurants, salons, clinics, consultants, and more.

Analytics and Reports

  • Receive booking stats and conversion reports in Telegram or WhatsApp.
  • Monitor chatbot performance from the WordPress admin mini dashboard.

Multilingual Support

The WordPress plugin interface and notifications are localized in these languages:

  • English (United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand)
  • Russian (Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Latvia, Estonia)
  • German (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Liechtenstein)
  • French (France, Belgium, Switzerland, Canada, Luxembourg)
  • Spanish (Spain, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru)
  • Ukrainian (Ukraine, Poland, Canada)
  • Italian (Italy, Switzerland, San Marino)
  • Polish (Poland, United Kingdom, Germany, Ireland)
  • Chinese (Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, China, Singapore)

External services

This plugin connects to the MyDeputy cloud service to deliver AI chat and booking features.

Data sent to the service includes site URL, site token, administrator email, and visitor chat/booking messages, but only after the administrator explicitly enables consent in plugin settings and clicks “Connect MyDeputy”.

You can request full data deletion at any time by disconnecting the plugin or contacting support.

Privacy policy: Privacy Policy
Terms of use: Terms of Use
Pricing: Pricing
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugins screen, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the MyDeputy menu in WordPress Admin.
  4. Enable External Services consent and save settings.
  5. Click Connect MyDeputy to create or link your account.
  6. Enable the chat widget.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free and open source. It connects to the MyDeputy cloud service, which includes a 14-day free trial.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The AI widget can process your WooCommerce catalog and answer product-related questions.

Can I train the AI with my own content?

Yes. You can train it from site pages, PDFs, WhatsApp, and Telegram updates.

Does the plugin send data before consent?

No. External services remain disabled until an administrator explicitly enables consent and connects the site.
